priority.P0: Keystone — blocks trustworthy numbers for everything downstream; build first.
priority.P1: High — directly corrupts metrics the user reads daily; independent, cheap.
priority.P2: Medium — residual risk / hardening; smaller blast radius.
priority.P3: Low — analysis/validation; depends on an upstream fix landing first.

status.DOCS_DRAFTED: Feature docs written, not yet reviewed (/review-docs pending).
status.DOCS_REVIEWED: Docs reviewed and scope approved; ready to implement.
status.IN_PROGRESS: At least one phase under implementation.
status.BLOCKED: Cannot start until a dependency lands.
status.DONE: All acceptance criteria verified; analyst re-run confirms fix.

legend.docsReviewed: true when the docs passed /review-docs even if status is BLOCKED (impl can't start yet). See the feature's review-notes.md.

features.title: Backtest Report Trust
features.origin: 2026-06-12 report F1/F2 + sizing note; reconfirmed 2026-06-16 F2/F3 (artifacts still live in DB)
features.summary: Make BacktestReport latest-per-cell (UPSERT + unique key + engineVersion), dedup the leaderboard and exclude 0-trade rows, and enforce the dead max_position_value cap so single-cell ROI/DD stays within one ₹10k slot. Keystone: every downstream ranking depends on it.

features.title: Live Trade Bookkeeping Hygiene
features.summary: Fix the live metrics the user actually reads: (a) add a BREAKEVEN band so sub-0.1R scratches stop inflating win-rate, and (b) write the final-leg P&L back to realizedPnl (or deprecate it) so SUM(realizedPnl) reconciles to SUM(pnl) — currently an ₹813 gap. Independent of FEAT-001.

features.title: Strategy-Level Selection Guard
features.origin: 2026-06-12 F4 + 2026-06-16 F4 (refined: broken cells already quarantined; risk is future re-promotion of a lucky cell)
features.summary: Per-cell gates already quarantine negative cells, but a lucky positive cell of a structurally-broken strategy (e.g. Bollinger, whose reliable-sample average is -15% to -21%) can still be auto-selected. Add a strategy-level guard: block any cell whose strategy's deduped reliable-sample average ROI is negative. Needs FEAT-001's deduped table to compute a trustworthy strategy average.

features.title: Live-vs-Backtest Reconciliation
features.origin: 2026-06-12 F3 + 2026-06-16 F1/F3 (every big live loser cell backtested positive)
features.summary: Every live-loss cell carries positive backtest expectancy — the system trades on numbers the market contradicts. This is a validation/reporting feature (walk-forward + Monte-Carlo bands per live-traded cell, surfaced so auto-select stops trusting inflated cells). BLOCKED until FEAT-001 makes backtest numbers trustworthy and FEAT-002 makes live numbers trustworthy.
